Requirement slug: lines-loop-symbol-flip

Task: fix(lines): effect symbol flip on unidirectional loop end when roundTrip is not enabled. Look at src/chart/helper/EffectLine.ts and EffectSymbol / src/chart/lines/*. Grep for "roundTrip" and the code computing symbol rotation from previous/current point. Report exact code.

Do NOT modify any files. Read the relevant code carefully (use rg/grep and Read). Your job is to produce an accurate, concrete implementation plan that another engineer can apply directly without re-reading much.

Requirements for your report:
- List every repo-relative file path that needs editing.
- Quote the EXACT current code (with file:line) at each site that must change.
- Give the exact replacement code where it is under ~40 lines.
- Note related call sites / type declarations that must change in sync.
- If tests exist under test/ut/spec that relate, name them.

Be precise and complete. Accuracy matters more than brevity, but do not dump whole files - quote only the relevant regions.

input.risks:
1. Type initialization: `__roundTrip: boolean` is added as a required member of the exported `ECSymbolOnEffectLine`, but the only construction site casts (`createSymbol(...) as ECSymbolOnEffectLine`, src/chart/helper/EffectLine.ts:81-85), exactly like the existing required `__t`/`__p1`/... members, so no compile error. `ECSymbolOnEffectLine` is imported by src/chart/helper/EffectPolyline.ts:21 only; no other file references it (`rg -n "ECSymbolOnEffectLine" src`).

2. `effect.roundTrip` has NO default in `LinesSeries.defaultOption` (src/chart/lines/LinesSeries.ts:399-407 defines only show/period/constantSpeed/symbol/symbolSize/loop/trailLength), so `effectModel.get('roundTrip')` is `undefined` unless the user sets it. Hence the `!!roundTrip` coercion in EDIT 2 (keeps the field a real boolean and keeps `isReverse` boolean). Optionally add `roundTrip: false` to that defaultOption block for clarity - not required, and note it does not change the `roundTrip !== this._roundTrip` guard outcome on first render because `period !== this._period` already forces the initial `_animateSymbol` call.

3. Ordering/lifecycle: `_updateSymbolPosition` runs from the animator `during` callback (src/chart/helper/EffectLine.ts:174-176). Assigning `symbol.__roundTrip` in `_updateEffectAnimation` before the restart guard (line 141) guarantees the flag is current on every `setOption`/`updateLayout` pass, including the case where the guard skips `_animateSymbol`. If `__roundTrip` were ever left `undefined` (e.g. a symbol animated by code paths not touched here), `isReverse` evaluates falsy -> forward tangent, which is the safe default.

4. roundTrip behavior is intentionally preserved exactly: `symbol.__t >= 1` is the logical negation of the old `symbol.__t < 1`, so with `roundTrip: true` the turnaround frame at `__t === 1` still uses the reversed tangent as today. Do not "tidy" it to `> 1` unless you accept that one-frame change at the apex.

5. Pre-existing, out-of-scope latent bug noticed while reading: when only `effect.symbol` changes, `_updateEffectSymbol` removes the old symbol and creates a new one, but the guard at src/chart/helper/EffectLine.ts:141 can then skip `_animateSymbol`, leaving the fresh symbol un-animated (`__t === undefined`). Do not try to fix it in this change; just be aware it is why `__roundTrip` must be assigned outside that guard.

6. Indentation: the current tangent block has inconsistent indentation (9 spaces on the `const ty` line, 17 on continuations) plus two blank lines after it; the replacement normalizes to 8/12 spaces. Run the repo lint (`npx eslint src/chart/helper/EffectLine.ts src/chart/helper/EffectPolyline.ts`) after editing.

7. No unit tests under test/ut/spec cover lines/effect lines (nothing matches `roundTrip`, `EffectLine`, or `EffectPolyline` under test/); verification is via the manual pages listed above. If a unit test is desired, it would have to drive zrender animation frames, which no existing spec does - consider it out of scope.
